MWCoop installs itself into AppData, with an \"MWCoop\" shortcut on the desktop. One launcher for My Winter Car and My Summer Car: nothing goes into the game folders.
Install in 3 steps
Unzip MWCoop wherever you like (Downloads, for example) and start MWCoop.exe.
Accept the install: MWCoop copies itself to %LOCALAPPDATA%\\MWCoop and creates the \"MWCoop\" shortcut on the desktop. The unzipped folder is no longer needed, you can delete it.
Pick your game (MSC or MWC, top left), your nickname, then HOST, JOIN or SOLO. That's it!
You had MWCoop in the game folder?

On first start, the launcher offers to move everything into AppData (co-op saves, settings, outfits, logs) and cleans the game folder: what MWCoop had put there goes to the Recycle Bin. Your game save, your mods and an official MSCLoader are not touched.
Start MWCoop from the desktop shortcut. A COPY of MWCoop.exe somewhere else would stop updating.
MWCoop installed in AppData (the launcher offers it on first start): nothing in the game folder.
Always start MWCoop from the \"MWCoop\" desktop shortcut.
If your antivirus complains: allow the %LOCALAPPDATA%\\MWCoop folder (exclusion), then start again.
MWCoop looks for the game in your Steam libraries and did not find it. Show it mywintercar.exe (Steam: right-click My Winter Car > Manage > Browse local files).
